request.hypothesis: During pod-kill, the in-memory cart state will be lost (causing checkout failures) and the system will recover by restarting the pod without data restoration.
request.reason: redis-cart is stateful and critical for cart/checkout journeys. Prior service-down runs show cart loss, but pod-kill (crash) effects are untested.
